newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Clariant, UBS lead Swiss shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Clariant, UBS lead Swiss shares higher.

text.p: 0900 GMT - Swiss shares were higher after the first hour of trade on Tuesday. UBS, for chart reasons, and Clariant, after the first quarter figures, were among the main winners, dealers said.
Dealers said trade was slowing down as the market waited for today's U.S. economic data.
Dealers said Clariant's first quarter sales rise of 11 percent in local currencies was better than expected.
Oerlikon-Buehrle said today first quarter operating profit was below last year's corresponding level.
Sika and Kuoni, both holding their annual media conference today, traded higher due to good first quarter results.
UBS added 14 francs to 1,367. Dealers said the share broke out of its recent price range.
Swiss Re added seven francs to 1,657.
